Status: wave 340: two HawkNET en/<>c property formatters named by what they format

Method.evidence: The en/<>c display class is the device property-formatter table; each lambda formats one property value for display. Two are distinguishable from their bodies alone: the one reading GetManufacturerData(ushort).Name and the one using ToSingle plus the single-argument Format.
Method.themes: Negative results recorded this turn: (1) the field oracle is closed - the 6.4 DevKit and HawkNET field inventories name their fields with obfuscator output or fixer placeholders (pPKUWl4tQJH, embeddedAttribute_0), so the DevKit event-accessor block cannot be named before its fields; (2) the remaining 50 en/<>c lambdas each format a different property and need the call site that registers them (the property id passed next to the delegate) before they can be named distinctly.
